notes.title: Expanded Multiplayer Lobbies & New Level
notes.content:
[b]Expanded Multiplayer Lobbies[/b]

The GnomeFire team are excited to announce the release of an expanded multiplayer lobby system that will allow you to:

[list]
[*] Play with up to 8 Racers
[*] Play with up to 4 Trappers
[*] Set Win Parameters (Kills, Laps, Round Time)
[*] Play in Teams or Free For All (FFA)
[*] Create Public, Private or Friends Only Lobbies
[*] Invite Steam Friends
[*] Live Ranking in Game
[/list]
[b] New Level Alert - Jungle [/b]

We've added a new level -- [b] Jungle [/b], featuring a group of enthusiastic mushrooms that cheer from their homes in the trees. Be sure to check it out!
